review_type: Independent semantic assessment of revised transfer artifacts
read_scope: Read only the requested rubric, regression criteria, four case packets, and all ten artifacts under the four specified results/revised directories. No skills, earlier outputs, other assessments, metadata, memories, or network sources were read.
verification_limit: Current source artifacts were checked directly. Execution logs were read as reported provenance; historical tool execution and rendering were not independently replayed.

summary.conclusion: Ecology, materials, and peer-review research pass all four criteria. Economics passes voice, evidence, and scope; coverage is qualified because R2.1 deliberately remains pending unavailable execution evidence. No demonstrated fabrication, prohibited edit, or preservation failure was found.
